name: GLEE
description: GLEE is a benchmark and framework for evaluating LLMs in language-based economic games, focusing on two-player sequential games inspired by economic literature. It standardizes evaluation of agent rationality, fairness, efficiency, and human-like behavior in strategic interactions using datasets of LLM vs. LLM and human vs. LLM interactions.
reputation: A niche benchmark for strategic interaction and economic-game behavior that is emerging in the LLM reasoning community but is not yet widely standardized.
notes: Includes open-source framework and datasets for economic game simulations; evaluates economic measures like efficiency and fairness.
